title: PixelKin - Driftholm (SNES register)
_note: Driftholm, the island town of the Farlamp Isles (10-the-farlamp-isles.md), in the long dark: eleven winters cut off by the Fogwall, keeping small lamps alone. THE ANCHOR of the Farlamp family: the isles' sea-hymn played straight - a minor-mode hymn, warm but lonely. 84 BPM, 3/4 (the Tide lilt), D minor with a harmonic-minor C# leading home. Motif = bars 1-2: the rope-pull (D5 up, A4 down) then the three-step haul D-E-F. Form A (16) B (8, relative F major: looking out to sea) A2 (the second line again, 8) = 32 bars, 68.6 s; the last bar's A4 pickup leads back to bar 1's D. SNES enrichment: pulse25 lead, strings pad (real chords), pluck harp quarter-arps, sparse bell = lamps in windows at phrase ends, flute answers in B only, tri_bass root (+fifth), a soft noise breath of surf every 4 bars. No drums - a hymn. Original (VISION.md).
